company.name: Klaim
company.shortDescription: Klaim is a healthcare fintech company providing fast payment solutions to boost healthcare providers' cash flow.
company.description: Klaim is a healthcare FinTech revolutionizing cash flow for healthcare providers through swift, seamless payment solutions. We act as a financial lifeline, purchasing outstanding medical claims to deliver immediate cash—empowering providers to pay bills, prioritize patients, and leave paperwork behind. Our cutting-edge technology streamlines the entire process, offering rapid turnarounds and minimal hassle. With Klaim, healthcare providers gain instant working capital to meet their needs, free from the delays and complexity of traditional financing.

productsAndServices.description: A claim purchasing service that provides healthcare providers with payment within 24 hours by buying their submitted insurance claims.
